QuestInfo.name: A Gift from Cole
QuestInfo.0: #rProfession Grand Opening Quest\n#k(Available until Jan 31st, 2011)#k\nTo celebrate reaching Lv #r4#k in Mining, #bCole#k has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Your hard work is being recognized. Congratulations!
QuestInfo.2: Master #bCole#k will have another gift for you once you reach Lv. #r10#k Mining. Keep up the good work!

0.0: Hey, #h0#! A Lv. 4 Miner already, huh? Ya work harder than I expected. Well, it's not every day yer student gets to be Lv. 4, so I suppose we should celebrate. At the very least, let me give you somethin'.

yes.0: Hold on, it's a little heavy. Talk to me again in just a sec.

no.0: Don't want anything? Fine, but I need to get rid of it by #rJanuary 31, 2011#k, so lemme know if you change your mind.

1.0: Yeah, you're welcome. Now keep up the hard work. Who knows, maybe you'll be a Lv.#r10#k Miner someday. Wouldn't that be somethin'?
